architecture.upgraded: compiled LangGraph StateGraph with typed state and conditional edges

groq_real_test.note: The strict schema and evidence validator were preserved; invalid generated content was never displayed.

comparison.evidence_validity: 1.0 before and after for deterministic reports; generated content now has a separate strict gate
comparison.fallback_reliability: automatic for missing key, timeout/quota/network/model/JSON/validation failures; covered by tests
comparison.workflow_behavior: now explicit, inspectable and conditionally routed by LangGraph
comparison.latency: LangGraph overhead is negligible relative to Olist analytics and collaborator calls; Groq generation took 2.7 to 4.3 seconds in the accepted demonstrations

limitations: Olist has no business-anomaly ground truth or causal impact labels.
Groq developer-tier TPM limits can affect an immediate correction request; deterministic fallback remains complete.
The exposed API key must be rotated before durable use.
